claims.hypothesis: Is the high-velocity gas a single outflow or two?
claims.experiment: CO(1-0) and CO(3-2) channel maps and PV diagrams at high resolution
claims.result: High-velocity emission separates into a wide pole-on component on N nucleus and a collimated N-S component around S nucleus
claims.finding: Each nucleus drives its own bipolar molecular outflow

evidence.quote: The high-velocity molecular gas previously found in the system is resolved to two components.

claims.hypothesis: Are the outflows significant relative to star formation?
claims.experiment: Compute outflow rates from high-velocity CO mass and crossing time
claims.finding: Outflows compare to or exceed total SFR, though dependent on X_CO

evidence.quote: either exceeds or compares to the total star formation rate in NGC 3256

claims.experiment: Compare CO with VLA 3.6 cm spurs, AGN constraints, and kinematics
claims.result: CO tips coincide with radio spurs; no bright submm core

evidence.quote: This model is, however, not yet proven and needs further studies for verification
